original_scope: No dedicated Vec2/Vec3 original GTest files found. Five original Vec4 tests are joined as shared implementation regressions, including matrix multiplication; no new original declaration credit.
method_changes: Expanded ElementCast primitive matrix across10 integral types, f32/f64 andbool; preserved legacy float->i32 behavior and restricted new oracle casts to native-defined floating range
Added raw GetData/ChangeData pointer adapters and mutable x/y/z/w reference getters
Added Vec3 planar constructor adapter supplying native default Z=0
Unsigned u8/u16/u32/u64/usize Modulus and Normalize now supported; unsigned wrapping-square case verified
Owned VectorArithmeticComponent policy implements promoted/narrowed primitive operations and default custom operator dispatch
Corrected narrow integer component arithmetic, Dot/Cross/scalar multiplication and division, signed narrow negation, compound assignments and integer Vec3/4 scalar division
Preserved custom value-vs-assignment operator dispatch with explicit empty policy implementations; added policy bound to3 generic helpers and MatrixScalar

vec2_method_scan.rust: Neg + VectorArithmeticComponent::vector_negate for signed/float/custom Neg types

declared_rust_adaptation: Custom arithmetic elements now opt in with impl VectorArithmeticComponent for MyElement {}. Default methods keep each existing Add versus AddAssign, Mul versus MulAssign, and Div versus DivAssign overload distinct. MatrixScalar requires this policy; custom magnitude implementations stay source-compatible and derive zero from empty magnitude unless overriding the default zero predicate.
remaining_gaps: Unsigned primitive unary negation and bool arithmetic remain constrained by Rust primitive operator bounds, despite native promoted operators being valid
i8 DX/DY still lacks From<u8>; generic Default uses T::default rather than native T(0) for custom element types
Out-of-range/NaN floating-to-integral conversions are native undefined behavior and excluded from new exact assertions; only existing i32 adapter retains pinned INT_MIN behavior
Signed overflowing promoted arithmetic and division by zero are native undefined behavior; wrapping implementations define a Rust extension without claiming native parity for that domain
Side-effecting custom scalar evaluation orders and arbitrary custom conversion operators are not exhaustively proven
No compiler surface credit or full Vec2/Vec3/Vec4 parity claim; cross-platform integer narrowing profile not executed
